Download printable motor spacers and the NEMA17 controller enclosure.

NEMA17 controller enclosure

42 × 42 mm base · 31 mm bolt pitch. The original v4 covers were modeled for PCB v1.0.57. Check the board revision and motor before printing a batch.

For a flat outer face, choose Plain top cover. Print its exterior face down; inspect the slicer before adding supports. The bottom housing replaces the old spacer.

  • Plain top cover · no sticker recess

    42 × 42 × 6.8 mm · Ø3.6 mm bores. Flat outer face for a fit-test print or UV laser marking. Bolt counterbores remain.

    STL · Plain top cover · no sticker recessSTEP · Plain top cover · no sticker recess

    Drag the model to rotate; scroll to zoom.

  • Top cover · sticker pocket

    42 × 42 × 6.8 mm · Ø3.6 mm bores. 38.7 × 19.65 × 0.3 mm pocket for the 38.1 × 19.05 mm label.

    STL · Top cover · sticker pocketSTEP · Top cover · sticker pocket

    Drag the model to rotate; scroll to zoom.

  • Rounded top cover · JST wire hood

    47 × 42 × 15.2 mm · Ø3.6 mm bores. PCB v1.0.45 fit-test draft. One-piece lid with a 5 mm, full-height rounded hood that covers the wire bend. The harness exits underneath. 20.2 mm assembled height.

    STL · Rounded top cover · JST wire hoodSTEP · Rounded top cover · JST wire hood

    Drag the model to rotate; scroll to zoom.

  • Bottom housing

    42 × 42 × 3.4 mm · Ø3.6 mm bores. Continuous exterior wall under the JST; replaces the old spacer.

    STL · Bottom housingSTEP · Bottom housing

    Drag the model to rotate; scroll to zoom.

Backface spacers

4 mm backface spacers for NEMA 8–34 and a 10 mm option for NEMA 17. Each has a 1 mm base and four sleeves with 45° corner cuts; total height includes the base.
